title: Join the Gaza Sunbirds in October for The Great Ride of Return Series
content:
The Gaza Sunbirds, Palestine’s para-cycling team of amputee athletes turned humanitarian aid organization, are working to support multiple rides this October in Wisconsin through local ride hosts, Great Ride MKE. Its goal is to bring people together through cycling and community and build solidarity. Find out how you can host one and where your local rides in the Wisconsin area will be happening…

The Great Ride of Return Series

The Great Ride of Return, a name and mission heavily inspired by the Great March of Return protests, uplifts the story of Sunbirds co-founder Alaa Al-Dali, an Olympic cycling hopeful who lost his leg after being shot by a sniper with an explosive round during the 2018 demonstrations.

The movement brings together thousands of participants across more than 95 cities and 35 countries who take to the streets in a showing of solidarity. Events aim to raise awareness for Palestinian mobility justice, demand an end to the occupation, and raise funds for essential aid distribution and disability rehabilitation in Gaza.

These rides are inspired by the courage and bravery of the Gaza Sunbirds. Participants of all ages gather to cycle peacefully, raise the Palestinian flag, and fund essential support for displaced families and disability rehabilitation. What began as solidarity rides has blossomed into an international campaign that merges the Sunbirds’ commitment to justice and inclusion with a collective call for freedom and peace.

Cycling stands at the heart of the Gaza Sunbirds story: wheels mean mobility, freedom, resilience, and non‑violent action. By cycling in solidarity, participants echo the Sunbirds—para‑athletes riding through adversity—and share that message of hope globally.

A Stayer Gaza Sunbirds prototype bike, which included a carbon fiber sleeve and metal armature, debuted at the 2025 Bespoked UK showcase 

While not all rides are fundraisers, many of these local rides also raise money. Hosts will link to the ongoing JustGiving fundraiser to collect donations. These contributions support humanitarian aid—food, hygiene kits, shelter—and para‑cycling gear in Gaza.

Funds help deliver essentials and empower amputee athletes striving to rebuild their lives.

October Rides in Milwaukee Hosted by Great Ride MKE

On October 11th, a slow-roll solidarity ride will meet at Urban Park Green Space (near Discovery World) at 1 PM.

On October 17th, there will be an advanced ride from Milwaukee to Madison, meeting at the Mitchell Park Domes at 10 AM

If your organization is hosting rides, please drop a link to them in the comments, and we’ll add them to this post. If you’re interested in hosting a ride in your city, you can apply to organize a Great Ride of Return event at the Gaza Sunbirds.
